inputs.name: GatewayImageValidator.parse.input
inputs.description: A record containing one gateway image input. parse reads an embedded data URI from image_url (a string or an object with url) first, otherwise it reads resource.mimeType/blob, source.media_type/data, or top-level mimeType/data; the bytes must be base64 PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP with a matching signature and no more than 5 MiB decoded, while remote URLs, local paths, and provider file IDs are unsupported.

outputs.name: GatewayImageValidator.parse
outputs.description: The validated image payload returned by parse. data is the canonical base64 block and mimeType is image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, or image/webp; the decoded bytes are at most 5 MiB and must match the declared MIME signature.

errors.name: gatewayContentError
errors.description: parse throws the error produced by gatewayContentError when the MIME type or data is missing, has the wrong kind, or uses an unsupported MIME type; when base64 is malformed, noncanonical, or exceeds the encoded or decoded size limits; or when decoded bytes do not match the declared image signature. The implementation uses messages for required PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP bytes, invalid or over-limit data, and invalid data or a MIME mismatch.
